title: Edge highlighting
description: Every optional member exercised for round-trip coverage.
purpose: Define edges and raised areas with a fine, lighter line to increase contrast.

steps.instruction: Thin a lighter tone of the base color to a smooth, flowing consistency.
Draw the brush along the topmost edges only, keeping the line fine.
steps.note: Less is more — build in passes.

parameters.name: Thinning
parameters.guidance: Thin with medium until it flows off the brush

commonProblems.problem: Lines look chalky or too wide
commonProblems.correction: Thin further and use fewer, lighter passes.

safetyNotes: Wash brushes promptly; some pigments are staining.

variants.name: Two-tone edge
variants.summary: A midtone edge followed by a fine brightest edge.
